variants.root_cause: Chromium can't allocate one 2,547,875,840-byte ArrayBuffer for the single external-data file (page fetchtest: 'RangeError: Array buffer allocation failed'; files up to 1.27 GB read whole); transformers.js reports it as 'Failed to fetch'. Same tensors split under 2 GB = variant fp32 (D-1416)

same_way: latency = audio handed in -> final text, after warm-up (two 1 s silences at load, then the first clip); cold start = process start -> model ready; peak GPU = nvidia-smi memory.used rise on the GPU
same_weights: both sides are openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo's weights (B: onnx-community's ONNX export of them)
precision_note: A runs fp16; B runs encoder fp32, decoder fp32. shader-f16 isn't offered by Chromium's WebGPU on this machine under any of 18 flag sets (docs/goals/43/webgpu-f16-probe.json), so B can't run fp16; B ran every precision that loads (fp32 only after its external data was split into files under 2 GB: one 2.55 GB ArrayBuffer can't be allocated) and the fastest within 0.01 WER of A was raced.
